topic: Choose the venue for our annual team offsite

scenario.topic: Choose the venue for our annual team offsite
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us for the offsite: convenience, atmosphere, activities, or budget?

options.name: Rooftop Lounge at Central Hotel
options.upside: Great city views and casual vibe
options.tradeoff: Limited privacy and potential noise from nearby streets
options.concern: Weather could affect comfort despite covered area

options.name: Lakeside Cabin Retreat
options.upside: Peaceful natural setting with outdoor activities
options.tradeoff: Longer travel time and less urban convenience
options.concern: Limited indoor space if weather turns bad

options.name: Private Dining Room at The Green Bistro
options.upside: Excellent food and private, quiet setting
options.tradeoff: Less space for activities beyond dining
options.concern: More formal atmosphere might limit casual interaction

options.name: Co-working Space Event Room
options.upside: Highly functional space for presentations and brainstorming
options.tradeoff: Less cozy and no food included in cost
options.concern: Might feel too much like a regular workday environment

shared_context: The offsite is planned for a Friday afternoon and evening in early September
The total budget for the venue rental and food is capped at $1500
The group size is exactly 3 participants
The goal is to have a relaxed but productive team bonding experience

personas.name: Nora
personas.background: I enjoy outdoor activities and connecting with nature, so a peaceful retreat with options for bonding appeals to me.
personas.private_goal: I want a relaxing offsite that encourages outdoor bonding and a break from the city.

personas.name: Ravi
personas.background: I value a lively atmosphere with great views and convenience close to the office for easy access.
personas.private_goal: I want a venue that offers a casual vibe and city views while being easy to get to.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference

personas.name: Tess
personas.background: I prefer a quiet, private setting with excellent food to foster meaningful conversations.
personas.private_goal: I want a venue that prioritizes food quality and privacy for a more intimate experience.
